title: Exercise 4.4 · Q29
summary: The principal of a high school calls 2 teachers, each of whom in turn calls 2 other teachers, and so on. In order to inform the entire staff, 6 rounds of calls are made. Counting the principal, how many people are in the staff?

steps.title: Spot the G.P.
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Round by round the number of people}\\[5pt]&\text{called doubles. Counting the principal:}\\[5pt]&\text{1, then 2, 4, 8, ...}\\[5pt]&1+2+4+8+16+32+64\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Sum
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&a_1=1,\ r=2,\ n=7\\[5pt]&S_7=\frac{1(2^7-1)}{2-1}=\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{127}}\\[5pt]&\text{There are 127 people on the staff.}\end{aligned}\]
